violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Interest Centers Always Visible to Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2605(1)(C))
violation_type.short_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Interest Centers Always Visible to Caregiver
violation_type.typical_finding: Book shelf created a blind spot in the classroom, which allowed inappropriate child-on-child contact.

finding_variants.text: Book shelf created a blind spot in the classroom, which allowed inappropriate child-on-child contact.
It was determined that the classroom furnisher was not arranged to where the children were visible at all times by the caregiver.
This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient.  Interest center was not visible to caregiver.
Activity centers in classrooms (6/6) did not have labels for designated play areas.
